newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen rising.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.03 up at 40.12 to the dolla in the kerb market on Thursday amid profit-taking in the U.S. currency, dealers said.
They said rising supply of dollars had prompted small players to book profits and predicted the rupee to rise further.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on September 10, was 36.9700/37.1549 rupees to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 8.40 percent compared to 9.0 percent on Wednesday.
